newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-GORAM RULED OUT OF RANGERS-AJAX CLASH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GORAM RULED OUT OF RANGERS-AJAX CLASH.

text.p: Glasgow Rangers goalkeeper Andy Goram has been ruled out of Wednesday's European Champions' League clash with Ajax Amsterdam with a hip injury, adding to the Scottish side's list of casualties.
The Scotland international will be replaced by Dutchman Theo Snelders, who returns to his home country to play only his third match for Rangers.

On a brighter note for manager Walter Smith, midfielder Stuart McCall has passed a fitness test and is certain to play in a side already missing Stephen Wright, Alan McLaren, David Robertson, Trevor Stephen, Ally McCoist and Gordon Durie.

Rangers' Danish striker Erik Bo Anderson is struggling to recover from a hamstring injury and Dutch striker Peter van Vossen, who was taken off on a stretcher in a league match at the weekend, is doubtful to play against his former club.
